name: mirage
text: The EV cross-check works now. The 00:34 pass returned 173 SharpAPI +EV lines at Novig (quality A 5, B 12, C 156), and they're being saved to the journal for grading beside Vigilant's own list. I'm still looking into why SharpAPI contributes so few fair odds to the +EV feed; the diagnostics for that are in v1.0.45, shipping now.
